edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: The Song of Songs, which belongs to Solomon.
verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים אֲשֶׁר לִשְׁלֹמֹה׃

verses.english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth, for your caresses are better than wine.
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׁקֵנִי מִנְּשִׁיקוֹת פִּיהוּ כִּי־טוֹבִים דֹּדֶיךָ מִיָּיִן׃

verses.english: Your oils are good to smell; your name is oil poured out. That is why young women love you.
verses.hebrew: לְרֵיחַ שְׁמָנֶיךָ טוֹבִים שֶׁמֶן תּוּרַק שְׁמֶךָ עַל־כֵּן עֲלָמוֹת אֲהֵבוּךָ׃

verses.english: Draw me after you; let us run! The king has brought me into his chambers. Let us exult and rejoice in you; let us celebrate your caresses more than wine. Rightly do they love you.
verses.hebrew: מָשְׁכֵנִי אַחֲרֶיךָ נָּרוּצָה הֱבִיאַנִי הַמֶּלֶךְ חֲדָרָיו נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בָּךְ נַזְכִּירָה דֹדֶיךָ מִיַּיִן מֵישָׁרִים אֲהֵבוּךָ׃

verses.english: I am black and beautiful, daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like Solomon's curtains.
verses.hebrew: שְׁחוֹרָה אֲנִי וְנָאוָה בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם כְּאָהֳלֵי קֵדָר כִּירִיעוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה׃

verses.english: Do not stare at me because I am dark, because the sun has gazed upon me. My mother's sons were angry with me; they made me keeper of the vineyards. My own vineyard I have not kept.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּרְאוּנִי שֶׁאֲנִי שְׁחַרְחֹרֶת שֶׁשֱּׁזָפַתְנִי הַשָּׁמֶשׁ בְּנֵי אִמִּי נִחֲרוּ־בִי שָׂמֻנִי נֹטֵרָה אֶת־הַכְּרָמִים כַּרְמִי שֶׁלִּי לֹא נָטָרְתִּי׃

verses.english: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you pasture, where you make the flock rest at noon. Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your companions?
verses.hebrew: הַגִּידָה לִּי שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי אֵיכָה תִרְעֶה אֵיכָה תַּרְבִּיץ בַּצָּהֳרָיִם שַׁלָּמָה אֶהְיֶה כְּעֹטְיָה עַל עֶדְרֵי חֲבֵרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: If you do not know, most beautiful among women, go out in the tracks of the flock and pasture your young goats beside the shepherds' dwellings.
verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא תֵדְעִי לָךְ הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים צְאִי־לָךְ בְּעִקְבֵי הַצֹּאן וּרְעִי אֶת־גְּדִיֹּתַיִךְ עַל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת הָרֹעִים׃

verses.english: I compare you, my companion, to my mare among Pharaoh's chariots.
verses.hebrew: לְסֻסָתִי בְּרִכְבֵי פַרְעֹה דִּמִּיתִיךְ רַעְיָתִי׃

verses.english: Your cheeks are beautiful with rows of ornaments, your neck with strings of beads.
verses.hebrew: נָאווּ לְחָיַיִךְ בַּתֹּרִים צַוָּארֵךְ בַּחֲרוּזִים׃

verses.english: We will make you rows of gold ornaments with studs of silver.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹרֵי זָהָב נַעֲשֶׂה־לָּךְ עִם נְקֻדּוֹת הַכָּסֶף׃

verses.english: While the king was at his reclining place, my nard gave its fragrance.
verses.hebrew: עַד־שֶׁהַמֶּלֶךְ בִּמְסִבּוֹ נִרְדִּי נָתַן רֵיחוֹ׃

verses.english: My beloved is to me a bundle of myrrh; he spends the night between my breasts.
verses.hebrew: צְרוֹר הַמֹּר דּוֹדִי לִי בֵּין שָׁדַי יָלִין׃

verses.english: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna in the vineyards of En-gedi.
verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁכֹּל הַכֹּפֶר דּוֹדִי לִי בְּכַרְמֵי עֵין גֶּדִי׃

verses.english: Look, you are beautiful, my companion! Look, you are beautiful; your eyes are doves.
verses.hebrew: הִנָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי הִנָּךְ יָפָה עֵינַיִךְ יוֹנִים׃

verses.english: Look, you are beautiful, my beloved, and delightful! Our bed, too, is leafy green.
verses.hebrew: הִנְּךָ יָפֶה דוֹדִי אַף נָעִים אַף־עַרְשֵׂנוּ רַעֲנָנָה׃

verses.english: The beams of our houses are cedars; our rafters are cypresses.
verses.hebrew: קֹרוֹת בָּתֵּינוּ אֲרָזִים רחיטנו [רַהִיטֵנוּ] בְּרוֹתִים׃

verses.english: I am a crocus of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי חֲבַצֶּלֶת הַשָּׁרוֹן שׁוֹשַׁנַּת הָעֲמָקִים׃

verses.english: Like a lily among thorns, so is my companion among the daughters.
verses.hebrew: כְּשׁוֹשַׁנָּה בֵּין הַחוֹחִים כֵּן רַעְיָתִי בֵּין הַבָּנוֹת׃

verses.english: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest, so is my beloved among the sons. I desired his shade and sat there; his fruit was sweet to my palate.
verses.hebrew: כְּתַפּוּחַ בַּעֲצֵי הַיַּעַר כֵּן דּוֹדִי בֵּין הַבָּנִים בְּצִלּוֹ חִמַּדְתִּי וְיָשַׁבְתִּי וּפִרְיוֹ מָתוֹק לְחִכִּי׃

verses.english: He brought me into the house of wine, and his banner over me was love.
verses.hebrew: הֱבִיאַנִי אֶל־בֵּית הַיָּיִן וְדִגְלוֹ עָלַי אַהֲבָה׃

verses.english: Support me with raisin cakes, spread apples beneath me, for I am sick with love.
verses.hebrew: סַמְּכוּנִי בָּאֲשִׁישׁוֹת רַפְּדוּנִי בַּתַּפּוּחִים כִּי־חוֹלַת אַהֲבָה אָנִי׃

verses.english: His left hand is beneath my head, and his right hand embraces me.
verses.hebrew: שְׂמֹאלוֹ תַּחַת לְרֹאשִׁי וִימִינוֹ תְּחַבְּקֵנִי׃

verses.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or by the does of the field: do not awaken or stir up love until it wishes.
verses.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם בִּצְבָאוֹת אוֹ בְּאַיְלוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה אִם־תָּעִירוּ וְאִם־תְּעוֹרְרוּ אֶת־הָאַהֲבָה עַד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּץ׃

verses.english: The voice of my beloved! Look, he comes, leaping over the mountains, bounding over the hills.
verses.hebrew: קוֹל דּוֹדִי הִנֵּה־זֶה בָּא מְדַלֵּג עַל־הֶהָרִים מְקַפֵּץ עַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת׃

verses.english: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look, he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹמֶה דוֹדִי לִצְבִי אוֹ לְעֹפֶר הָאַיָּלִים הִנֵּה־זֶה עוֹמֵד אַחַר כָּתְלֵנוּ מַשְׁגִּיחַ מִן־הַחֲלֹּנוֹת מֵצִיץ מִן־הַחֲרַכִּים׃

verses.english: My beloved answered and said to me: Rise, my companion, my beautiful one, and come away.
verses.hebrew: עָנָה דוֹדִי וְאָמַר לִי קוּמִי לָךְ רַעְיָתִי יָפָתִי וּלְכִי־לָךְ׃

verses.english: For look, winter has passed; the rain has gone, departed.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה הסתו [הַסְּתָיו] עָבָר הַגֶּשֶׁם חָלַף הָלַךְ לוֹ׃

verses.english: The blossoms have appeared in the land; the time of singing has arrived, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
verses.hebrew: הַנִּצָּנִים נִרְאוּ בָאָרֶץ עֵת הַזָּמִיר הִגִּיעַ וְקוֹל הַתּוֹר נִשְׁמַע בְּאַרְצֵנוּ׃

verses.english: The fig tree has ripened its early figs, and the blossoming vines have given fragrance. Rise, my companion, my beautiful one, and come away.
verses.hebrew: הַתְּאֵנָה חָנְטָה פַגֶּיהָ וְהַגְּפָנִים סְמָדַר נָתְנוּ רֵיחַ קוּמִי לכי [לָךְ] רַעְיָתִי יָפָתִי וּלְכִי־לָךְ׃

verses.english: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding place of the steep slope, let me see your appearance; let me hear your voice, for your voice is sweet and your appearance beautiful.
verses.hebrew: יוֹנָתִי בְּחַגְוֵי הַסֶּלַע בְּסֵתֶר הַמַּדְרֵגָה הַרְאִינִי אֶתּ־מַרְאַיִךְ הַשְׁמִיעִינִי אֶת־קוֹלֵךְ כִּי־קוֹלֵךְ עָרֵב וּמַרְאֵיךְ נָאוֶה׃

verses.english: Catch the foxes for us, the little foxes that ruin vineyards, for our vineyards are in blossom.
verses.hebrew: אֶחֱזוּ־לָנוּ שׁוּעָלִים שׁוּעָלִים קְטַנִּים מְחַבְּלִים כְּרָמִים וּכְרָמֵינוּ סְמָדַר׃

verses.english: My beloved is mine, and I am his; he pastures among the lilies.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹדִי לִי וַאֲנִי לוֹ הָרֹעֶה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים׃

verses.english: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, turn, my beloved; be like a gazelle or a young stag upon the mountains of Bether.
verses.hebrew: עַד שֶׁיָּפוּחַ הַיּוֹם וְנָסוּ הַצְּלָלִים סֹב דְּמֵה־לְךָ דוֹדִי לִצְבִי אוֹ לְעֹפֶר הָאַיָּלִים עַל־הָרֵי בָתֶר׃

verses.english: On my bed at night I sought the one my soul loves; I sought him but did not find him.
verses.hebrew: עַל־מִשְׁכָּבִי בַּלֵּילוֹת בִּקַּשְׁתִּי אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי בִּקַּשְׁתִּיו וְלֹא מְצָאתִיו׃

verses.english: Let me rise now and go around the city, through the streets and squares; let me seek the one my soul loves. I sought him but did not find him.
verses.hebrew: אָקוּמָה נָּא וַאֲסוֹבְבָה בָעִיר בַּשְּׁוָקִים וּבָרְחֹבוֹת אֲבַקְשָׁה אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי בִּקַּשְׁתִּיו וְלֹא מְצָאתִיו׃

verses.english: The watchmen going around the city found me. Have you seen the one my soul loves?
verses.hebrew: מְצָאוּנִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַסֹּבְבִים בָּעִיר אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי רְאִיתֶם׃

verses.english: Scarcely had I passed them when I found the one my soul loves. I held him and would not let him go until I had brought him into my mother's house, into the chamber of the one who conceived me.
verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט שֶׁעָבַרְתִּי מֵהֶם עַד שֶׁמָּצָאתִי אֵת שֶׁאָהֲבָה נַפְשִׁי אֲחַזְתִּיו וְלֹא אַרְפֶּנּוּ עַד־שֶׁהֲבֵיאתִיו אֶל־בֵּית אִמִּי וְאֶל־חֶדֶר הוֹרָתִי׃

verses.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or by the does of the field: do not awaken or stir up love until it wishes.
verses.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם בִּצְבָאוֹת אוֹ בְּאַיְלוֹת הַשָּׂדֶה אִם־תָּעִירוּ וְאִם־תְּעוֹרְרוּ אֶת־הָאַהֲבָה עַד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּץ׃

verses.english: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like columns of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with every powder of the trader?
verses.hebrew: מִי זֹאת עֹלָה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּר כְּתִימֲרוֹת עָשָׁן מְקֻטֶּרֶת מוֹר וּלְבוֹנָה מִכֹּל אַבְקַת רוֹכֵל׃

verses.english: Look, Solomon's litter! Sixty mighty men surround it, from the mighty men of Israel.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה מִטָּתוֹ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹה שִׁשִּׁים גִּבֹּרִים סָבִיב לָהּ מִגִּבֹּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: All of them grasp a sword, trained for war, each with his sword upon his thigh, against terrors in the night.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם אֲחֻזֵי חֶרֶב מְלֻמְּדֵי מִלְחָמָה אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל־יְרֵכוֹ מִפַּחַד בַּלֵּילּוֹת׃

verses.english: King Solomon made himself a carrying chair from the timber of Lebanon.
verses.hebrew: אַפִּרְיוֹן עָשָׂה לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה מֵעֲצֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן׃

verses.english: He made its pillars silver, its support gold, its seat purple; its interior was inlaid with love from the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: עַמּוּדָיו עָשָׂה כֶסֶף רְפִידָתוֹ זָהָב מֶרְכָּבוֹ אַרְגָּמָן תּוֹכוֹ רָצוּף אַהֲבָה מִבְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Go out and look, daughters of Zion, at King Solomon wearing the crown with which his mother crowned him on his wedding day, on the day his heart rejoiced.
verses.hebrew: צְאֶינָה וּרְאֶינָה בְּנוֹת צִיּוֹן בַּמֶּלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה בָּעֲטָרָה שֶׁעִטְּרָה־לּוֹ אִמּוֹ בְּיוֹם חֲתֻנָּתוֹ וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַת לִבּוֹ׃

verses.english: Look, you are beautiful, my companion! Look, you are beautiful; your eyes are doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down Mount Gilead.
verses.hebrew: הִנָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי הִנָּךְ יָפָה עֵינַיִךְ יוֹנִים מִבַּעַד לְצַמָּתֵךְ שַׂעְרֵךְ כְּעֵדֶר הָעִזִּים שֶׁגָּלְשׁוּ מֵהַר גִּלְעָד׃

verses.english: Your teeth are like a flock of shorn sheep coming up from washing, all bearing twins, with none bereaved among them.
verses.hebrew: שִׁנַּיִךְ כְּעֵדֶר הַקְּצוּבוֹת שֶׁעָלוּ מִן־הָרַחְצָה שֶׁכֻּלָּם מַתְאִימוֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָה אֵין בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: Your lips are like a scarlet thread, and your speech is lovely. Your temple is like a slice of pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.hebrew: כְּחוּט הַשָּׁנִי שִׂפְתֹתַיִךְ וּמִדְבָּרֵיךְ נָאוֶה כְּפֶלַח הָרִמּוֹן רַקָּתֵךְ מִבַּעַד לְצַמָּתֵךְ׃

verses.english: Your neck is like David's tower, built in courses; a thousand shields hang upon it, all the bucklers of mighty men.
verses.hebrew: כְּמִגְדַּל דָּוִיד צַוָּארֵךְ בָּנוּי לְתַלְפִּיּוֹת אֶלֶף הַמָּגֵן תָּלוּי עָלָיו כֹּל שִׁלְטֵי הַגִּבּוֹרִים׃

verses.english: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle, grazing among the lilies.
verses.hebrew: שְׁנֵי שָׁדַיִךְ כִּשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים תְּאוֹמֵי צְבִיָּה הָרוֹעִים בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים׃

verses.english: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and the hill of frankincense.
verses.hebrew: עַד שֶׁיָּפוּחַ הַיּוֹם וְנָסוּ הַצְּלָלִים אֵלֶךְ לִי אֶל־הַר הַמּוֹר וְאֶל־גִּבְעַת הַלְּבוֹנָה׃

verses.english: You are altogether beautiful, my companion, and there is no blemish in you.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּךְ יָפָה רַעְיָתִי וּמוּם אֵין בָּךְ׃

verses.english: With me from Lebanon, bride, with me from Lebanon you shall come. Look down from the summit of Amana, from the summit of Senir and Hermon, from lions' dens, from leopards' mountains.
verses.hebrew: אִתִּי מִלְּבָנוֹן כַּלָּה אִתִּי מִלְּבָנוֹן תָּבוֹאִי תָּשׁוּרִי מֵרֹאשׁ אֲמָנָה מֵרֹאשׁ שְׂנִיר וְחֶרְמוֹן מִמְּעֹנוֹת אֲרָיוֹת מֵהַרְרֵי נְמֵרִים׃

verses.english: You have captured my heart, my sister, bride; you have captured my heart with one of your eyes, with one ornament from your necklace.
verses.hebrew: לִבַּבְתִּנִי אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה לִבַּבְתִּינִי באחד [בְּאַחַת] מֵעֵינַיִךְ בְּאַחַד עֲנָק מִצַּוְּרֹנָיִךְ׃

verses.english: How beautiful are your caresses, my sister, bride! How much better your caresses than wine, and the fragrance of your oils than all spices!
verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּפוּ דֹדַיִךְ אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה מַה־טֹּבוּ דֹדַיִךְ מִיַּיִן וְרֵיחַ שְׁמָנַיִךְ מִכָּל־בְּשָׂמִים׃

verses.english: Your lips drip honeycomb sweetness, bride; honey and milk are beneath your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
verses.hebrew: נֹפֶת תִּטֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתַיִךְ כַּלָּה דְּבַשׁ וְחָלָב תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנֵךְ וְרֵיחַ שַׂלְמֹתַיִךְ כְּרֵיחַ לְבָנוֹן׃

verses.english: A locked garden is my sister, bride; a locked spring, a sealed fountain.
verses.hebrew: גַּן נָעוּל אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה גַּל נָעוּל מַעְיָן חָתוּם׃

verses.english: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates with choice fruits, henna with nard,
verses.hebrew: שְׁלָחַיִךְ פַּרְדֵּס רִמּוֹנִים עִם פְּרִי מְגָדִים כְּפָרִים עִם־נְרָדִים׃

verses.english: nard and saffron, aromatic reed and cinnamon, with every frankincense tree, myrrh and aloes, with all the finest spices.
verses.hebrew: נֵרְדְּ וְכַרְכֹּם קָנֶה וְקִנָּמוֹן עִם כָּל־עֲצֵי לְבוֹנָה מֹר וַאֲהָלוֹת עִם כָּל־רָאשֵׁי בְשָׂמִים׃

verses.english: A fountain of gardens, a well of living water, and streams flowing from Lebanon.
verses.hebrew: מַעְיַן גַּנִּים בְּאֵר מַיִם חַיִּים וְנֹזְלִים מִן־לְבָנוֹן׃

verses.english: Awake, north wind, and come, south wind! Blow upon my garden; let its spices flow. Let my beloved come into his garden and eat its choice fruits.
verses.hebrew: עוּרִי צָפוֹן וּבוֹאִי תֵימָן הָפִיחִי גַנִּי יִזְּלוּ בְשָׂמָיו יָבֹא דוֹדִי לְגַנּוֹ וְיֹאכַל פְּרִי מְגָדָיו׃

verses.english: I have come into my garden, my sister, bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Eat, companions; drink and become drunk, lovers!
verses.hebrew: בָּאתִי לְגַנִּי אֲחֹתִי כַלָּה אָרִיתִי מוֹרִי עִם־בְּשָׂמִי אָכַלְתִּי יַעְרִי עִם־דִּבְשִׁי שָׁתִיתִי יֵינִי עִם־חֲלָבִי אִכְלוּ רֵעִים שְׁתוּ וְשִׁכְרוּ דּוֹדִים׃

verses.english: I sleep, but my heart is awake. The voice of my beloved knocking! Open to me, my sister, my companion, my dove, my perfect one, for my head is filled with dew, my locks with the drops of night.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְשֵׁנָה וְלִבִּי עֵר קוֹל דּוֹדִי דוֹפֵק פִּתְחִי־לִי אֲחֹתִי רַעְיָתִי יוֹנָתִי תַמָּתִי שֶׁרֹּאשִׁי נִמְלָא־טָל קְוֻּצּוֹתַי רְסִיסֵי לָיְלָה׃

verses.english: I have taken off my tunic; how could I put it on? I have washed my feet; how could I soil them?
verses.hebrew: פָּשַׁטְתִּי אֶת־כֻּתָּנְתִּי אֵיכָכָה אֶלְבָּשֶׁנָּה רָחַצְתִּי אֶת־רַגְלַי אֵיכָכָה אֲטַנְּפֵם׃

verses.english: My beloved reached his hand through the opening, and my inward parts stirred for him.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹדִי שָׁלַח יָדוֹ מִן־הַחֹר וּמֵעַי הָמוּ עָלָיו׃

verses.english: I rose to open to my beloved; my hands dripped myrrh, my fingers flowing myrrh, upon the handles of the bolt.
verses.hebrew: קַמְתִּי אֲנִי לִפְתֹּחַ לְדוֹדִי וְיָדַי נָטְפוּ־מוֹר וְאֶצְבְּעֹתַי מוֹר עֹבֵר עַל כַּפּוֹת הַמַּנְעוּל׃

verses.english: I opened to my beloved, but my beloved had slipped away, gone. My soul went out when he spoke. I sought him but did not find him; I called him, but he did not answer me.
verses.hebrew: פָּתַחְתִּי אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי וְדוֹדִי חָמַק עָבָר נַפְשִׁי יָצְאָה בְדַבְּרוֹ בִּקַּשְׁתִּיהוּ וְלֹא מְצָאתִיהוּ קְרָאתִיו וְלֹא עָנָנִי׃

verses.english: The watchmen going around the city found me; they struck me, they wounded me. The guards of the walls took my mantle from me.
verses.hebrew: מְצָאֻנִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַסֹּבְבִים בָּעִיר הִכּוּנִי פְצָעוּנִי נָשְׂאוּ אֶת־רְדִידִי מֵעָלַי שֹׁמְרֵי הַחֹמוֹת׃

verses.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem: if you find my beloved, what will you tell him? That I am sick with love.
verses.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם אִם־תִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־דּוֹדִי מַה־תַּגִּידוּ לוֹ שֶׁחוֹלַת אַהֲבָה אָנִי׃

verses.english: What is your beloved more than another beloved, most beautiful among women? What is your beloved more than another beloved, that you have adjured us this way?
verses.hebrew: מַה־דּוֹדֵךְ מִדּוֹד הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים מַה־דּוֹדֵךְ מִדּוֹד שֶׁכָּכָה הִשְׁבַּעְתָּנוּ׃

verses.english: My beloved is radiant and ruddy, distinguished among ten thousand.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹדִי צַח וְאָדוֹם דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה׃

verses.english: His head is gold, refined gold; his locks are waving, black as a raven.
verses.hebrew: רֹאשׁוֹ כֶּתֶם פָּז קְוּצּוֹתָיו תַּלְתַּלִּים שְׁחֹרוֹת כָּעוֹרֵב׃

verses.english: His eyes are like doves beside channels of water, bathed in milk, seated in a full setting.
verses.hebrew: עֵינָיו כְּיוֹנִים עַל־אֲפִיקֵי מָיִם רֹחֲצוֹת בֶּחָלָב יֹשְׁבוֹת עַל־מִלֵּאת׃

verses.english: His cheeks are like a bed of spices, towers of aromatic herbs; his lips are lilies dripping flowing myrrh.
verses.hebrew: לְחָיָו כַּעֲרוּגַת הַבֹּשֶׂם מִגְדְּלוֹת מֶרְקָחִים שִׂפְתוֹתָיו שׁוֹשַׁנִּים נֹטְפוֹת מוֹר עֹבֵר׃

verses.english: His hands are rods of gold set with tarshish stone; his belly is polished ivory overlaid with sappir stones.
verses.hebrew: יָדָיו גְּלִילֵי זָהָב מְמֻלָּאִים בַּתַּרְשִׁישׁ מֵעָיו עֶשֶׁת שֵׁן מְעֻלֶּפֶת סַפִּירִים׃

verses.english: His legs are pillars of alabaster founded upon bases of refined gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as the cedars.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹקָיו עַמּוּדֵי שֵׁשׁ מְיֻסָּדִים עַל־אַדְנֵי־פָז מַרְאֵהוּ כַּלְּבָנוֹן בָּחוּר כָּאֲרָזִים׃

verses.english: His palate is sweetness, and all of him is desirable. This is my beloved, and this is my companion, daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: חִכּוֹ מַמְתַקִּים וְכֻלּוֹ מַחֲּמַדִּים זֶה דוֹדִי וְזֶה רֵעִי בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Where has your beloved gone, most beautiful among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?
verses.hebrew: אָנָה הָלַךְ דּוֹדֵךְ הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים אָנָה פָּנָה דוֹדֵךְ וּנְבַקְשֶׁנּוּ עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spice, to pasture in the gardens and gather lilies.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹדִי יָרַד לְגַנּוֹ לַעֲרוּגוֹת הַבֹּשֶׂם לִרְעוֹת בַּגַּנִּים וְלִלְקֹט שׁוֹשַׁנִּים׃

verses.english: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine; he pastures among the lilies.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי וְדוֹדִי לִי הָרֹעֶה בַּשׁוֹשַׁנִּים׃

verses.english: You are beautiful, my companion, like Tirzah, lovely like Jerusalem, awesome like armies with banners.
verses.hebrew: יָפָה אַתְּ רַעְיָתִי כְּתִרְצָה נָאוָה כִּירוּשָׁלִָם אֲיֻמָּה כַּנִּדְגָּלוֹת׃

verses.english: Turn your eyes away from me, for they overwhelm me. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down from Gilead.
verses.hebrew: הָסֵבִּי עֵינַיִךְ מִנֶּגְדִּי שֶׁהֵם הִרְהִיבֻנִי שַׂעְרֵךְ כְּעֵדֶר הָעִזִּים שֶׁגָּלְשׁוּ מִן־הַגִּלְעָד׃

verses.english: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes coming up from washing, all bearing twins, with none bereaved among them.
verses.hebrew: שִׁנַּיִךְ כְּעֵדֶר הָרְחֵלִים שֶׁעָלוּ מִן־הָרַחְצָה שֶׁכֻּלָּם מַתְאִימוֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָה אֵין בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: Your temple is like a slice of pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.hebrew: כְּפֶלַח הָרִמּוֹן רַקָּתֵךְ מִבַּעַד לְצַמָּתֵךְ׃

verses.english: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and young women without number.
verses.hebrew: שִׁשִּׁים הֵמָּה מְּלָכוֹת וּשְׁמֹנִים פִּילַגְשִׁים וַעֲלָמוֹת אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: My dove, my perfect one, is the only one; she is the only one of her mother, the pure one of the woman who bore her. Daughters saw her and called her blessed; queens and concubines praised her.
verses.hebrew: אַחַת הִיא יוֹנָתִי תַמָּתִי אַחַת הִיא לְאִמָּהּ בָּרָה הִיא לְיוֹלַדְתָּהּ רָאוּהָ בָנוֹת וַיְאַשְּׁרוּהָ מְלָכוֹת וּפִילַגְשִׁים וַיְהַלְלוּהָ׃

verses.english: Who is this looking forth like dawn, beautiful like the moon, pure like the sun, awesome like armies with banners?
verses.hebrew: מִי־זֹאת הַנִּשְׁקָפָה כְּמוֹ־שָׁחַר יָפָה כַלְּבָנָה בָּרָה כַּחַמָּה אֲיֻמָּה כַּנִּדְגָּלוֹת׃

verses.english: I went down to the walnut garden to look at the fresh growth of the wadi, to see whether the vine had blossomed, whether the pomegranates had flowered.
verses.hebrew: אֶל־גִּנַּת אֱגוֹז יָרַדְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּאִבֵּי הַנָּחַל לִרְאוֹת הֲפָרְחָה הַגֶּפֶן הֵנֵצוּ הָרִמֹּנִים׃

verses.english: I did not know; my soul set me among the chariots of my noble people.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יָדַעְתִּי נַפְשִׁי שָׂמַתְנִי מַרְכְּבוֹת עַמִּי־נָדִיב׃

verses.english: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may look at you. Why would you look at the Shulammite as at a dance of the two camps?
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבִי שׁוּבִי הַשּׁוּלַמִּית שׁוּבִי שׁוּבִי וְנֶחֱזֶה־בָּךְ מַה־תֶּחֱזוּ בַּשּׁוּלַמִּית כִּמְחֹלַת הַמַּחֲנָיִם׃

verses.english: How beautiful are your steps in sandals, noble daughter! The curves of your thighs are like ornaments, the work of a craftsman's hands.
verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּפוּ פְעָמַיִךְ בַּנְּעָלִים בַּת־נָדִיב חַמּוּקֵי יְרֵכַיִךְ כְּמוֹ חֲלָאִים מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָמָּן׃

verses.english: Your navel is a rounded bowl; let it not lack mixed wine. Your belly is a heap of wheat enclosed by lilies.
verses.hebrew: שָׁרְרֵךְ אַגַּן הַסַּהַר אַל־יֶחְסַר הַמָּזֶג בִּטְנֵךְ עֲרֵמַת חִטִּים סוּגָה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים׃

verses.english: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
verses.hebrew: שְׁנֵי שָׁדַיִךְ כִּשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים תָּאֳמֵי צְבִיָּה׃

verses.english: Your neck is like an ivory tower; your eyes are pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bath-rabbim. Your nose is like Lebanon's tower looking toward Damascus.
verses.hebrew: צַוָּארֵךְ כְּמִגְדַּל הַשֵּׁן עֵינַיִךְ בְּרֵכוֹת בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן עַל־שַׁעַר בַּת־רַבִּים אַפֵּךְ כְּמִגְדַּל הַלְּבָנוֹן צוֹפֶה פְּנֵי דַמָּשֶׂק׃

verses.english: Your head upon you is like Carmel, and the flowing hair of your head is like purple; a king is held captive in the tresses.
verses.hebrew: רֹאשֵׁךְ עָלַיִךְ כַּכַּרְמֶל וְדַלַּת רֹאשֵׁךְ כָּאַרְגָּמָן מֶלֶךְ אָסוּר בָּרְהָטִים׃

verses.english: How beautiful and how delightful you are, love, among delights!
verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּפִית וּמַה־נָּעַמְתְּ אַהֲבָה בַּתַּעֲנוּגִים׃

verses.english: This stature of yours is like a palm tree, and your breasts like clusters.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת קוֹמָתֵךְ דָּמְתָה לְתָמָר וְשָׁדַיִךְ לְאַשְׁכֹּלוֹת׃

verses.english: I said: I will climb the palm tree; I will grasp its branches. Let your breasts be like clusters of the vine, and the fragrance of your breath like apples,
verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי אֶעֱלֶה בְתָמָר אֹחֲזָה בְּסַנְסִנָּיו וְיִהְיוּ־נָא שָׁדַיִךְ כְּאֶשְׁכְּלוֹת הַגֶּפֶן וְרֵיחַ אַפֵּךְ כַּתַּפּוּחִים׃

verses.english: and your palate like good wine, flowing smoothly to my beloved, making the lips of sleepers move.
verses.hebrew: וְחִכֵּךְ כְּיֵין הַטּוֹב הוֹלֵךְ לְדוֹדִי לְמֵישָׁרִים דּוֹבֵב שִׂפְתֵי יְשֵׁנִים׃

verses.english: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי לְדוֹדִי וְעָלַי תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ׃

verses.english: Come, my beloved, let us go out into the field; let us spend the night in the villages.
verses.hebrew: לְכָה דוֹדִי נֵצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה נָלִינָה בַּכְּפָרִים׃

verses.english: Let us rise early for the vineyards; let us see whether the vine has blossomed, whether its flower has opened, whether the pomegranates have flowered. There I will give you my caresses.
verses.hebrew: נַשְׁכִּימָה לַכְּרָמִים נִרְאֶה אִם פָּרְחָה הַגֶּפֶן פִּתַּח הַסְּמָדַר הֵנֵצוּ הָרִמּוֹנִים שָׁם אֶתֵּן אֶת־דֹּדַי לָךְ׃

verses.english: The mandrakes have given fragrance, and at our doors are all choice fruits, new as well as old, which I have stored for you, my beloved.
verses.hebrew: הַדּוּדָאִים נָתְנוּ־רֵיחַ וְעַל־פְּתָחֵינוּ כָּל־מְגָדִים חֲדָשִׁים גַּם־יְשָׁנִים דּוֹדִי צָפַנְתִּי לָךְ׃

verses.english: If only you were like a brother to me, one who nursed at my mother's breasts! If I found you outside, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.
verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֶּנְךָ כְּאָח לִי יוֹנֵק שְׁדֵי אִמִּי אֶמְצָאֲךָ בַחוּץ אֶשָׁקְךָ גַּם לֹא־יָבוּזוּ לִי׃

verses.english: I would lead you, bring you into my mother's house; she would teach me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.hebrew: אֶנְהָגֲךָ אֲבִיאֲךָ אֶל־בֵּית אִמִּי תְּלַמְּדֵנִי אַשְׁקְךָ מִיַּיִן הָרֶקַח מֵעֲסִיס רִמֹּנִי׃

verses.english: His left hand is beneath my head, and his right hand embraces me.
verses.hebrew: שְׂמֹאלוֹ תַּחַת רֹאשִׁי וִימִינוֹ תְּחַבְּקֵנִי׃

verses.english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem: why awaken or stir up love before it wishes?
verses.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּעְתִּי אֶתְכֶם בְּנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם מַה־תָּעִירוּ וּמַה־תְּעֹרְרוּ אֶת־הָאַהֲבָה עַד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּץ׃

verses.english: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? Beneath the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother labored with you; there she who bore you labored.
verses.hebrew: מִי זֹאת עֹלָה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּר מִתְרַפֶּקֶת עַל־דּוֹדָהּ תַּחַת הַתַּפּוּחַ עוֹרַרְתִּיךָ שָׁמָּה חִבְּלַתְךָ אִמֶּךָ שָׁמָּה חִבְּלָה יְלָדַתְךָ׃

verses.english: Set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm, for love is strong as death, jealousy unyielding as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a flame of Yah.
verses.hebrew: שִׂימֵנִי כַחוֹתָם עַל־לִבֶּךָ כַּחוֹתָם עַל־זְרוֹעֶךָ כִּי־עַזָּה כַמָּוֶת אַהֲבָה קָשָׁה כִשְׁאוֹל קִנְאָה רְשָׁפֶיהָ רִשְׁפֵּי אֵשׁ שַׁלְהֶבֶתְיָה׃

verses.english: Many waters cannot quench love, nor can rivers sweep it away. If a man gave all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly despised.
verses.hebrew: מַיִם רַבִּים לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְכַבּוֹת אֶת־הָאַהֲבָה וּנְהָרוֹת לֹא יִשְׁטְפוּהָ אִם־יִתֵּן אִישׁ אֶת־כָּל־הוֹן בֵּיתוֹ בָּאַהֲבָה בּוֹז יָבוּזוּ לוֹ׃

verses.english: We have a little sister, and she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?
verses.hebrew: אָחוֹת לָנוּ קְטַנָּה וְשָׁדַיִם אֵין לָהּ מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַאֲחֹתֵנוּ בַּיּוֹם שֶׁיְּדֻבַּר־בָּהּ׃

verses.english: If she is a wall, we will build a silver battlement upon her; if she is a door, we will enclose her with a cedar plank.
verses.hebrew: אִם־חוֹמָה הִיא נִבְנֶה עָלֶיהָ טִירַת כָּסֶף וְאִם־דֶּלֶת הִיא נָצוּר עָלֶיהָ לוּחַ אָרֶז׃

verses.english: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. Then I became in his eyes like one who finds peace.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי חוֹמָה וְשָׁדַי כַּמִּגְדָּלוֹת אָז הָיִיתִי בְעֵינָיו כְּמוֹצְאֵת שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he gave the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand pieces of silver for its fruit.
verses.hebrew: כֶּרֶם הָיָה לִשְׁלֹמֹה בְּבַעַל הָמוֹן נָתַן אֶת־הַכֶּרֶם לַנֹּטְרִים אִישׁ יָבִא בְּפִרְיוֹ אֶלֶף כָּסֶף׃

verses.english: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are yours, Solomon, and two hundred belong to those who keep its fruit.
verses.hebrew: כָּרְמִי שֶׁלִּי לְפָנָי הָאֶלֶף לְךָ שְׁלֹמֹה וּמָאתַיִם לְנֹטְרִים אֶת־פִּרְיוֹ׃

verses.english: You who dwell in the gardens, companions are listening to your voice; let me hear it.
verses.hebrew: הַיוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּגַּנִּים חֲבֵרִים מַקְשִׁיבִים לְקוֹלֵךְ הַשְׁמִיעִינִי׃

verses.english: Flee, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag upon the mountains of spices.
verses.hebrew: בְּרַח דּוֹדִי וּדְמֵה־לְךָ לִצְבִי אוֹ לְעֹפֶר הָאַיָּלִים עַל הָרֵי בְשָׂמִים׃
